paras.en: The Brewers have shown how you ruin baseball, develop superstars like Garrett Mitchell, sign the best free agents available like Jake Bauers, use Cy Young caliber pitchers like Shane Drohan, Dustin May, JoJo Romero and Aaron Ashby to shut down talented offenses, and listen when your manager tells you to hit home runs or put the ball in play to the correct spot, instead of making outs.

That's the right way to play the game, and the Brewers do it in spades. The Dodgers, after playing the game the right way in 2024 and 2025, stopped playing the game the right way in 2026, and it cost them.

For Los Angeles, it's a depressing end to what seemed like a dynasty. In 2024 and 2025, the breaks, the clutch hitting and the quality pitching went their way. In 2026, that all came back to bite them in a single series. Milwaukee, though, proved why they should always have been overwhelming favorites to win the World Series: they simply have better players who are able to choose to hit .500 when it matters, instead of playing like they have their entire careers.

Sarcasm aside, that's how baseball works. The teams that win get hot at the right time, and all the payroll and talent in the world can't predict which teams will get hot at the right time. There's no explanation for it, it's not a process or approach thing, there's nothing to learn from it, it's not meaningful or predictive, the postseason is a tournament, and tournaments have weird outcomes.

Milwaukee will now advance to face the winner of the Guardians-Rays series, while the Dodgers will start the long offseason targeting their next class of highly paid stars: David Hamilton and Jake Bauers.

articles.title: Jerry Seinfeld turns tables on radical anti-Israel agitators after chaotic Chicago stunt backfires

paras.en: Comedian Jerry Seinfeld turned the tables on anti-Israel hecklers who attempted to derail his Chicago performance last Friday, mocking the protesters as security removed them from the venue.

Viral video from the confrontation shows activists shouting at Seinfeld at the Chicago Theatre, accusing Israel of committing "genocide" in Gaza and alleging that American taxpayer dollars are funding the deaths of thousands of civilians.
"Twenty-two thousand Palestinians who are children now are killed with our taxpayer money, and you’re making jokes!" a woman shouted in clips posted online.

Seinfeld then dances on stage and mocks the protesters with sarcastic remarks, calling himself "racist" and saying, "It’s a genocide. I’m into it." He also joked that he would find out how much the protesters paid for their tickets and send the money directly to Israel.
As security personnel escorted the demonstrators out of the auditorium, one audience member shouted, "Rough her up!"

The Anti-War Committee Chicago and the Chicago branch of the US Palestinian Community Network have taken credit for organizing the disruption, writing on Instagram, "Friday’s disruption sent a clear message: Those who defend Israel’s genocide and ethnic cleansing of Palestinians in Gaza and throughout Palestine will be met with protest and are not welcome on Chicago’s stages without opposition."
Fox News Digital reached out to Seinfeld’s team for comment but did not hear back.
The altercation is the latest in a string of protests targeting the 72-year-old Jewish comedian over his staunch defense of Israel.
Comedian and media analyst Tim Young told Fox News Digital he believes protesters are paying top dollar to hijack comedy shows for viral attention rather than political discourse.

"They know that once they start yelling, everyone will whip their cameras out, and it is a very direct interaction and maybe one of the only direct interactions protesters get to have with celebrities and with the internet," Young said.
"If you are in a very intimate environment where everyone is quiet, listening to one person, you will be heard. And, so, that's what they're taking advantage of here."
Young compared the disruptions at Seinfeld's shows to protests at political rallies, arguing that some activists are willing to pay steep ticket prices to confront the comedian.

"It seems like people are going to Jerry Seinfeld's shows like they're going to a Trump rally to protest," Young said. "They wanted to get Jerry's attention. They want to, for some reason, they're very, very adamant on getting him to react to the Israel-Palestine conflict."
Young also linked the disruptions to Seinfeld's past criticism of performing at universities.
"It's why Jerry doesn't like to go and perform at college campuses. And he said he hates performing at college campuses specifically for that reason," Young said.
"He doesn't want to get into the political thing. He doesn't want to have protesters yelling back and forth with him. It's a waste of the rest of the audience's time, and he knows that."
In May 2024, dozens of students walked out during Seinfeld's commencement address at Duke University, some holding Palestinian flags.

Seinfeld returned to the university in September 2025 to introduce freed Israeli hostage Omer Shem Tov at a campus event, where he addressed anti-Israel protests, saying, "Free Palestine is, to me, just — you’re free to say you don’t like Jews. Just say you don’t like Jews."

"By saying ‘Free Palestine,’ you’re not admitting what you really think," he said. "So, it’s actually — compared to the Ku Klux Klan, I’m actually thinking the Klan is actually a little better here because they can come right out and say, ‘We don’t like Blacks, we don’t like Jews.’ OK, that’s honest."

Seinfeld also faced controversy overseas last month when several European acts withdrew from the inaugural MEO Commedia a La Carte Fest in Lisbon, Portugal, where he is scheduled to headline later this year.

The acts did not name Seinfeld directly in their withdrawal statements, but some cited concerns about the Israel-Gaza conflict. One performer said someone involved in the festival defended ideas they considered indefensible.
Young, who previously dismissed efforts to cancel Seinfeld over his support for Israel, argued that protesters target the billionaire comedian because of his influence and celebrity status.
"This is all about control. It's all about power. And it's all about the left having power over these very influential and powerful people," Young said. "And they’re not having it."

articles.title: Sydney suburb Dulwich Hill in lockdown as police search for man seen with shotgun
articles.author: Ben Doherty

paras.en: A large swathe of Dulwich Hill in Sydney’s inner west has been locked down by police as they search for a man reportedly carrying a shotgun.
The man allegedly set alight a stolen car and menaced witnesses with the weapon before fleeing on foot.
A police helicopter and armed tactical police focused their search for the man on an area around Williams Parade and Constitution Road.

Police were called to a car park on Williams Parade at about 10.20am on Friday in response to reports of a stolen vehicle. Officers were told a man carrying a longarm weapon was sitting inside the vehicle. It is alleged the man then set the car alight before fleeing on foot.
Three witnesses told police the man threatened them with the weapon.
Speaking to reporters, police Supt Despa Fitzgerald said: “Do not approach this person – we understand he’s armed with a shotgun.”
She said there was no indication shots had been fired.

Police described the man as being of Caucasian appearance, aged in his 20s, about 160cm tall and of thin build, with shaggy hair. He was last seen on Union Street wearing a blue T-shirt and long black pants.
No injuries have been reported. Police doorknocked the neighbourhood, telling residents to stay inside.
Light rail services in the area were suspended and nearby businesses and cafes asked to close their doors.
Nearby primary schools, Dulwich Hill public school and Summer Hill public school, were put on lockout.
Canterbury Girls High School, which was hosting HSC exams on Friday, was also put into lockout mode, with restrictions on people entering and leaving the school.
People outside the police exclusion zone are being advised to avoid the area.

articles.title: French police accused over war-like injuries to teenagers in school protests
articles.author: Angelique Chrisafis in Paris

paras.en: French lawyers and rights groups have said that several teenagers have suffered war-like injuries from police weapons used during school protests, and an unprecedented number of children have been held in police custody, some of whom reported being hit or racially insulted.
paras.zh: 法国律师和人权组织表示，几名青少年在学校抗议活动中使用警方武器，遭受了类似战争的伤害，被警方拘留的儿童数量前所未有，其中一些人报告称遭到殴打或种族侮辱。

paras.en: France is in the fourth week of its biggest youth protest movement in decades, during which hundreds of high schools across the country have been blockaded as students demand the replacement of absent teachers and repairs to decrepit buildings.
paras.zh: 法国正处于数十年来最大规模的青年抗议运动的第四周，在此期间，全国数百所高中被封锁，因为学生要求更换缺席的教师并修复破旧的建筑物。

paras.en: Police have opened internal investigations into 36 allegations of officer violence against demonstrators, including four children allegedly being “mutilated” by explosive weapons, and six sustaining “significant injuries”, as well as other complaints over physical blows, insults or alleged sexual assault, the interior minister, Laurent Nuñez, told the senate.
paras.zh: 内政部长劳伦特·努涅斯（ Laurent Nuñez ）告诉参议院，警方已经开始对36起针对示威者的警察暴力行为的指控进行内部调查，其中包括4名据称被爆炸性武器“肢解”的儿童，以及6名持续“严重受伤”的儿童，以及其他有关身体打击、侮辱或涉嫌性侵犯的投诉。

paras.en: Evan, a 15-year-old studying carpentry at a vocational high school, had a hand blown off in the explosion of a police stun grenade outside a school protest in Lens, northern France, on 5 October. His lawyer, Bertrand Wattez, said: “His injuries resemble war injuries.”
paras.zh: 10月5日，在法国北部Lens的学校抗议活动外，一枚警察眩晕手榴弹爆炸， 15岁的Evan在一所职业高中学习木工。他的律师伯特兰·瓦特兹（ Bertrand Wattez ）说： “他的伤势类似于战争伤。”

paras.en: Wattez said Evan had gone to school to attend class and discovered a protest under way. He said Evan had not taken part in violence and denied the Béthune state prosecutor’s assertion that the grenade had been picked up from the ground. When the grenade exploded, Evan lost his left hand, several fingers from his right hand and suffered injuries to other parts of his body. He remained in hospital “in a very difficult condition” and his family had filed a criminal complaint, Wattez said.
paras.zh: Wattez说， Evan去学校上课，发现抗议活动正在进行中。他说，埃文没有参与暴力，并否认了贝蒂纳州检察官关于手榴弹是从地上捡起的说法。手榴弹爆炸时， Evan失去了左手，右手失去了几根手指，身体其他部位受伤。Wattez说，他仍然“处于非常困难的状态” ，他的家人已经提起刑事诉讼。

paras.en: Another boy, Eden, 14 – who had been near a school protest in Saint-Ouen-l’Aumône, north-west of Paris – suffered extensive facial injuries, including two fractures to his jaw, the loss of his bottom teeth and all his top teeth broken after he was allegedly hit by a shot from a grenade launcher.

His lawyer, Elsa Marcel, said the shot from a grenade launcher was fired at close range, from a distance of 1.5 metres. “This is the equivalent of war weaponry,” she said. The family has filed a legal complaint for attempted murder.

Eden’s parents said he had gone to school but found it blockaded and had wanted to go home. Video footage appeared to show him facing three riot police officers. One officer hit out in his direction with a truncheon and Eden kicked in the direction of the police before a grenade shot was fired. An officer has been suspended and placed under official investigation.

This week, a police officer in the western city of Tours was charged with aggravated battery after Maël, a 16-year-old at a vocational high school, lost the use of his eye allegedly after a shot from a form of rubber-bullet launcher. The officer denies the charges. The family’s lawyer said Maël had not been involved in any violent confrontation with police but had simply been present at a school protest, and that the family felt a sense of “injustice”.

For several years, France has faced scrutiny over police use of explosive weapons, particularly after serious injuries were reported during the 2018-2019 gilets jaunes (yellow vests) street demonstrations, including allegations that people had lost eyes and had their hands and feet mutilated.

The current wave of protests has also led to lawyers raising concerns that an unprecedented number of children have been arrested and placed in police custody, with some lawyers reporting that teenagers said they were hit, humiliated or verbally abused during arrests.

Since the school protests began in mid-September, a total of 6,773 under-18s have been taken into police custody after they were arrested, the justice ministry said. For more than 1,000 of those children, no charges were brought; 2,190 are facing legal action and almost 2,000 were handed an alternative to further legal action, such as a citizenship course, without their case being heard at trial and without a conviction.
Lawyers said accusations against children included gathering with violent intent, violence against police and damage to property.

Nathalie Tehio, a lawyer and the president of the French Human Rights League, said the fact that only a minority of children’s cases would end up before a judge raised concerns that arrests could be unfounded. She said: “There are a record number of arrests … Often, the legal dossiers are empty. In reality, this is more about stopping people from demonstrating. I think there is a sense of hitting hard to try to dissuade people and scare them.”
Tehio said: “We have received accounts of racist comments made. Lawyers have told us that their clients say they have been humiliated or treated violently or pushed.”

Romain Boulet, a co-president of France’s Association of Criminal Lawyers, said: “Criminal lawyers are worried and raising concerns about the potential misuse of police powers to dissuade citizens aged under 18 from demonstrating.”

Mohamed Jaite, the president of the Paris branch of the leftwing union Syndicat des Avocats de France, has represented several teenagers stopped in Paris and its suburbs. “I have seen one youth limping in a police station,” he said. “Some have reported being humiliated or receiving racist and sexist insults.”

Prisca Ancion, a lawyer from the leftwing lawyers’ group Collectif d’Action Judiciaire, which demonstrated this week in front of a high school in Saint-Denis, in the northern suburbs of Paris, said: “There have been racist insults during arrests, as well as homophobic, sexist comments or sexual touching. We encourage families to file complaints.”
Another lawyer from the collective, Romane Bartoli, who assisted several teenagers after their arrest, said: “Youngsters told us they were slapped, kicked or punched.”

One 16-year-old from a high school in a suburb north of Paris described being arrested 100 metres from his school on the day of a blockade in late September. He plans to study medicine at university and said he had intended to go to class before he saw there was a protest.
Answering questions from the Guardian with his lawyer, he said he had been held in police custody for more than 12 hours, mostly with two others in a police cell with two mattresses.
“It was hard psychologically because I felt I hadn’t done anything wrong,” he said. “I was hit with a truncheon and punched.”

He said a police officer told him to “shut his mouth” and said: “It’s always you lot,” which he understood to be a racist insult. He was released after a state prosecutor instructed him to carry out a citizenship course as an alternative to facing legal action.
The justice ministry and the interior ministry, which oversees policing, did not comment on allegations of insults or violence in police custody.
In parliament, Nuñez denied any form of excessive policing or police repression. He suspended the use of stun grenades at school demonstrations.

Audrey Bailleul, a magistrate and national representative of the Union Syndicale des Magistrats, said it was hard to have a clear view of events at this stage. She said: “There is nothing to show that there has voluntarily been a massive intention to not respect [legal] procedure.”

articles.title: Future of western security is at stake in Yemen civil war, says country’s former PM
articles.author: Patrick Wintour Diplomatic editor

paras.en: The future of western security is being fought out in the mountains and hills surrounding the south-western Yemeni city of Taiz, the country’s former prime minster has said.
paras.zh: 也门前总理表示，西部安全的未来正在也门西南部城市塔伊兹周围的山区和丘陵中展开。

paras.en: Maeen Abdulmalik Saeed, now an adviser to Yemen’s president, said it would be catastrophic if the city fell to the Iran-backed Houthi rebels, since control of the strategic Bab al-Mandab strait in the Red Sea and the road to Aden – the site of the UN-recognised government – would be lost.
paras.zh: 现任也门总统顾问的Maeen Abdulmalik Saeed表示，如果这座城市落入伊朗支持的胡塞叛乱分子手中，那将是灾难性的，因为红海的战略Bab al-Mandab海峡和通往亚丁的道路（联合国承认的政府所在地）将失去控制。

paras.en: Appealing for more western help, Saeed said he had no doubt that the Houthis intended to seize control of all of Yemen, and claimed their goal was “to help Iran to expand the chaos”.
paras.zh: 赛义德呼吁西方提供更多帮助，表示他毫不怀疑胡塞武装打算夺取也门全境的控制权，并声称他们的目标是“帮助伊朗扩大混乱局面”。

paras.en: Saeed admitted the lack of coordination among government-backed troops, competition between Gulf states and a slowness to appreciate the implications of Yemen acquiring long-range drone technology had contributed to the pressure facing his government, and its chief backer Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 赛义德承认，政府支持的军队之间缺乏协调，海湾国家之间的竞争以及对也门获得远程无人机技术的影响认识迟缓，导致其政府及其主要支持者沙特阿拉伯面临压力。

paras.en: “We only have light weapons and Saudi Arabia did not plan at an early stage for this escalation, but it is never too late to regain our position,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说： “我们只有轻武器，沙特阿拉伯在早期阶段没有计划升级，但恢复我们的立场永远不会太晚。”

paras.en: Saeed called on the west to think through the implications of allowing the Houthis to take control of Yemen, arguing the country would never be secure with Houthis on the land.
paras.zh: 赛义德呼吁西方国家仔细考虑允许胡塞武装控制也门的影响，认为该国与胡塞武装在这片土地上永远不会安全。

paras.en: Saeed is not only an adviser to the Yemeni president, Rashad al-Alimi, he was prime minister between 2018 and 2024 and a former negotiator with the Houthis.
paras.zh: 赛义德不仅是也门总统拉沙德·阿利米（ Rashad al-Alimi ）的顾问，他在2018年至2024年期间担任总理，也是胡塞武装的前谈判代表。

paras.en: He said: “The battle around Taiz is not just a battle for Taiz, but a broader battle that involves the whole of the western world, and one of the most important maritime straits. The Houthis know controlling Taiz is controlling the straits and it’s the highlands before the straits and the coastal city of Mocha and the Gulf of Aden. If Taiz is lost, access to the strait will be lost. The rest of the country will come later. The Houthi plan is to control the whole of Yemen.”
paras.zh: 他说： “围绕塔伊兹的战斗不仅仅是塔伊兹的战斗，而是一场涉及整个西方世界的更广泛的战斗，也是最重要的海上海峡之一。胡塞知道控制塔伊兹正在控制海峡，这是海峡前的高地以及沿海城市摩卡和亚丁湾。如果塔伊兹丢失，通往海峡的通道也将丢失。全国其他地区将在稍后推出。胡塞的计划是控制整个也门。”

paras.en: Taiz has become the new frontline in the war between the Houthis and Yemeni government forces after the Houthis launched a military campaign last month to take Yemen’s Red Sea coast, ending four years of relative calm in Yemen after a UN-brokered ceasefire froze the frontlines in 2022.
paras.zh: 塔伊兹已经成为胡塞武装和也门政府军之间战争的新前线，此前胡塞武装上个月发起了一场夺取也门红海沿岸的军事行动，结束了也门四年的相对平静，此前联合国斡旋的停火在2022年冻结了前线。

paras.en: He said existing intelligence showed the Houthis were already seeking to control parts of the south, including the former Soviet camp at al-Sabiha, in the Lahij governorate, and eventually Aden. “The Houthis bleed a lot,” he said, “they suffer a lot, but they always want quickly to use their gains or any collapse to gain more land.”
paras.zh: 他说，现有的情报显示，胡塞武装已经在寻求控制南部的部分地区，包括前苏联在拉哈伊省al-Sabiha的营地，并最终控制亚丁。“胡塞分子流了很多血，”他说， “他们遭受了很多痛苦，但他们总是希望迅速利用他们的收益或任何崩溃来获得更多的土地。”

paras.en: With some Houthi leaders offering safe passage to armed groups to leave the city, he said for now the Houthis were allowing some fuel and commodities into the urban area of Taiz which houses more than 500,000 people, but in the meantime they were expanding their control of rural areas and smaller major cities.
paras.zh: 他说，由于一些胡塞领导人向武装团体提供安全通道离开该市，目前胡塞允许一些燃料和商品进入居住着50多万人的塔伊兹市区，但与此同时，他们正在扩大对农村地区和较小主要城市的控制。

paras.en: Saeed said: “In a matter of days there will be a full siege and they will try to enter the city. I know the Houthis. They will show some flexibility until they are ready to control. It will be much worse than the siege of 2015. It will be catastrophic.”
paras.zh: 赛义德说： “几天之内就会有全面围攻，他们会试图进入这座城市。我认识胡塞武装。在准备好控制之前，他们会表现出一定的灵活性。这将比2015年的围攻要糟糕得多。这将是灾难性的。”

paras.en: He described Taiz as a modern democratic city untied to tribal culture, and predicted the Houthis would try to impose their Zaydi education, financial and tax systems very quickly, but the citizens would continue to resist. “The loss of Taiz would have a very significant symbolic impact on the idea of the modern state in Yemen and of resisting the Houthi project which relies on tribal networks and extremist religious education.”
paras.zh: 他将塔伊兹描述为一个与部落文化无关的现代民主城市，并预测胡塞武装将很快试图强加他们的扎伊迪教育、金融和税收制度，但公民将继续抵制。“失去塔伊兹将对也门的现代国家理念和抵制依赖部落网络和极端主义宗教教育的胡塞项目产生非常重要的象征性影响。”

paras.en: Saeed admitted Taiz only had light weapons and the government had not been prepared for the loss of the west coast, allowing the Houthis to attack Taiz from four different axes.
paras.zh: 赛义德承认，塔伊兹只有轻武器，政府没有为西海岸的损失做好准备，允许胡塞武装从四个不同的轴心攻击塔伊兹。

paras.en: “We have good troops,” he said, “but the problem is the coordination. We needed more communication between the National Shield Forces, National Resistance Forces and the Giants Brigades. It’s been a wake-up call inside the government and the army because not enough happened between the truce of 2022 and the restart of the fighting this year to reorganise the troops. The Houthi ideology solely is to fight.”
paras.zh: “我们有很好的部队，”他说， “但问题在于协调。我们需要国家盾牌部队、国家抵抗力量和巨人旅之间更多的沟通。这是政府和军队内部的警钟，因为在2022年休战和今年重启战斗以重组军队之间发生的事情还不够多。胡塞的意识形态完全是为了战斗。”

paras.en: He added: “I hope now that the knife has come to our neck, and the Houthis represent a critical threat, the priority would be to come together to defeat the Houthis, and then to discuss other demands and guarantees.”
paras.zh: 他补充说： “我希望现在刀子已经到了我们的脖子上，而胡塞武装是一个严重的威胁，当务之急是团结起来击败胡塞武装，然后讨论其他要求和保证。”

paras.en: The exiled leader of the southern secessionist force, Aidarous al-Zubaidi, on Tuesday called for a mobilisation of southern troops against the Houthis, but coupled this with a demand for a referendum on secession within two years. He brought tens of thousands on to the streets in support on Wednesday, but his return would be a bitter pill for Riyadh to swallow.
paras.zh: 南方分离主义势力的流亡领导人艾达鲁斯·祖拜迪（ Aidarous al-Zubaidi ）周二呼吁动员南方军队对抗胡塞武装，但同时要求在两年内就分离问题举行公投。周三，他带着成千上万的人走上街头支持，但他的回归将是利雅得吞下的苦药。

paras.en: Saeed said it was not a coincidence that the Houthi attack along the Red Sea coast in September had come when Iran was under heavy pressure.
paras.zh: 赛义德表示， 9月份胡塞武装在红海沿岸发动袭击时，伊朗承受着巨大压力，这并非巧合。

paras.en: “Its airplanes and airports cannot operate, 90% of the oil was coming out of Hormuz. That is why they attacked the Saudi east-to-west pipelines. The Houthis, by talking about a Saudi blockade, have found a reason to hit the Saudi oil installations, airports and they want to do it now because the only thing Iran can do is to keep expanding the consequences of the war for America.”
paras.zh: “它的飞机和机场无法运营， 90%的石油来自霍尔木兹。这就是他们攻击沙特东西输油管道的原因。胡塞武装通过谈论沙特的封锁，已经找到了打击沙特石油设施和机场的理由，他们现在想要这样做，因为伊朗唯一能做的就是继续扩大战争对美国的影响。”

paras.en: He said Houthi military capability and negotiating power had been transformed over the last decade leading to its ability to target key sites in Saudi Arabia now. “In 2017, the Houthis had nothing but blind missiles to fire at us that missed their targets.” By 2020, he said intelligence existed that Iranian experts operating from the Houthi capital Sana’a were training Houthis and in December of that year, in a devastatingly effective attack, they fired ballistic missiles at Aden airport. The attack left 28 dead and 107 injured, including Saeed himself, newly installed as prime minister. The missile travelled 186 miles (299km).
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: He explained: “We thought even then they did not have that many missiles, but since then the Iranians have expanded their manufacturing lines.” In January 2022, using missiles, the Houthis attacked Abu Dhabi oil tanker trucks more than 900 miles away.
paras.zh: 他解释说： “即使在那时，我们也认为他们没有那么多导弹，但从那时起，伊朗人就扩大了他们的生产线。“ 2022年1月，胡塞武装使用导弹袭击了900多英里外的阿布扎比油罐车。

paras.en: In October 2022, inside Yemen, they struck the Nushayma oil terminal and al-Dhabba port, severely damaging government finances. By the time the US attacked Yemen in March 2025, he said “it was clear the Houthis had dozens of targeted missiles, land sea missiles and drones. They had become a unified front with Iran, and developed their missile base.”
paras.zh: 2022年10月，在也门境内，他们袭击了Nushayma石油码头和al-Dhabba港口，严重损害了政府财政。到2025年3月美国袭击也门时，他说： “很明显，胡塞武装拥有数十枚定向导弹、陆海导弹和无人机。他们已经成为与伊朗的统一战线，并发展了他们的导弹基地。”

paras.en: He warned: “This is a new era of radical terrorism. It is not the old chaotic one of Isis and al-Qaida. It is semi-state actors and militias threatening powerful states with cheap technologies, and smuggled third-party components. The way Iran has invested in the Houthis could become a model for threatening navigation elsewhere. It is a new model of war, without traditional armies, needing different air defences. Gulf countries have to reshape and rethink their defences”.
paras.zh: 他警告说： “这是一个激进恐怖主义的新时代。这不是伊斯兰国和基地组织的旧混乱。它是半国家行为者和民兵，用廉价的技术和走私的第三方组件威胁强大的国家。伊朗对胡塞武装的投资方式可能会成为威胁其他地方航行的典范。这是一种新的战争模式，没有传统的军队，需要不同的防空系统。海湾国家必须重塑和重新思考其防御。”

articles.title: Houthi missile attack on Yemeni presidential palace kills five, minister says

paras.en: Five people have been killed and 16 injured in a Houthi missile attack targeting the presidential palace in the port city of Aden in southern Yemen, which is the seat of the internationally-recognised government, officials say.
paras.zh: 官员说，胡塞导弹袭击了也门南部港口城市亚丁的总统府，造成5人死亡， 16人受伤。该港口城市是国际公认的政府所在地。

paras.en: Information Minister Moammar al-Eryani told the BBC that the prime minister and other ministers were unhurt when five ballistic missiles hit al-Maashiq Palace.
paras.zh: 新闻部长Moammar al-Eryani告诉英国广播公司，当五枚弹道导弹袭击al-Maashiq宫时，总理和其他部长没有受伤。

paras.en: The Houthis' military spokesman, Yahya Sarea, said they struck "the Saudi enemy's military operations headquarters in Aden".
paras.zh: 胡塞武装的军事发言人叶海亚·萨里亚（ Yahya Sarea ）说，他们袭击了“沙特敌人在亚丁的军事行动总部”。

paras.en: A coalition led by Saudi Arabia backs the government and is providing air support for an offensive by pro-government forces against the Iran-backed Houthis.
paras.zh: 由沙特阿拉伯领导的联盟支持政府，并为亲政府部队对伊朗支持的胡塞武装的进攻提供空中支援。

paras.en: Yemeni health minister Qasim Buhaibeh said the casualties included "those working to guard the site and civilian employees".
paras.zh: 也门卫生部长卡西姆·布海贝（ Qasim Buhaibeh ）表示，伤亡人员包括“那些守卫现场的人员和文职人员”。

paras.en: The country's Prime Minister Shaya Zindani condemned the Houthis' attack on Aden, calling it "cowardly" and a "continuation of their criminal behaviour".
paras.zh: 该国总理沙亚·津达尼（ Shaya Zindani ）谴责胡塞武装对亚丁的袭击，称其为“懦弱”和“犯罪行为的延续”。

paras.en: He said the government continued to carry out its duties and vowed that it would not weaken the resolve of its forces to continue operations against the Houthis on Yemen's south-western Red Sea coast and other front lines.
paras.zh: 他说，政府继续履行职责，并发誓不会削弱其部队在也门西南红海海岸和其他前线继续打击胡塞武装的决心。

paras.en: Earlier, the Houthis denied that they had attacked Saudi Arabia on Thursday, after the coalition said its forces had intercepted a cruise missile in the Medina region, home to one of Islam's holiest shrines.
paras.zh: 早些时候，胡塞武装否认他们周四袭击了沙特阿拉伯，此前该联盟表示，其部队在麦地那地区拦截了一枚巡航导弹，麦地那是伊斯兰教最神圣的圣地之一。

paras.en: The Houthis have been launching missiles and drones at airports, oil and gas facilities, and military bases in Saudi Arabia in retaliation for the strikes on the territory that they control in western Yemen, including the capital Sanaa.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装一直在向沙特阿拉伯的机场、石油和天然气设施以及军事基地发射导弹和无人机，以报复对他们在也门西部控制的领土（包括首都萨那）的袭击。

paras.en: On Saturday, a Houthi missile strike killed 13 people at Riyadh's international airport, which was the deadliest attack in Saudi Arabia in more than a decade.
paras.zh: 星期六，胡塞导弹袭击在利雅得国际机场造成13人死亡，这是十多年来沙特阿拉伯最致命的袭击事件。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia's deputy foreign minister accused Iran of encouraging the Houthis to escalate their conflict with the kingdom.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯副外长指责伊朗鼓励胡塞武装升级与王国的冲突。

paras.en: "Iran continues to arm, train and support the Houthi militia in violation of UN Security Council resolutions," Rayed Krimly told reporters, according to AFP news agency.
paras.zh: “伊朗继续违反联合国安理会决议，武装、训练和支持胡塞民兵，” Rayed Krimly告诉记者。

paras.en: "We think that the escalation by the Houthis at this latest stage of the conflict is encouraged by Iran," he added.
paras.zh: “我们认为，伊朗鼓励胡塞武装在冲突的最后阶段升级，”他补充说。

paras.en: There was no immediate response from Iran's government. However, it has previously denied supplying weapons to the Houthis and said it only supports them politically.
paras.zh: 伊朗政府没有立即做出回应。然而，它此前否认向胡塞武装提供武器，并表示只在政治上支持他们。

paras.en: Iran's foreign minister has also said it is ready to provide "any assistance necessary to facilitate the start of talks" between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis.
paras.zh: 伊朗外交部长还表示，它准备提供“任何必要的援助，以促进沙特阿拉伯和胡塞武装之间开始谈判”。

paras.en: Yemen has been devastated by a civil war that began in 2014, when the Houthis ousted the internationally-recognised government from Sanaa. The conflict escalated in 2015, after the Saudi-led coalition of Arab states intervened in an attempt to restore the government's rule.
paras.zh: 也门遭受了始于2014年的内战的破坏，当时胡塞武装从萨那驱逐了国际公认的政府。在沙特领导的阿拉伯国家联盟干预试图恢复政府统治之后，冲突在2015年升级。

paras.en: A four-year-old informal ceasefire began to unravel in July, when the Houthis announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia and began missile and drone attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities and tankers in the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 7月，长达四年的非正式停火开始瓦解，当时胡塞武装宣布对沙特阿拉伯实施“海上禁运” ，并开始对红海的沙特机场、石油设施和油轮发动导弹和无人机袭击。

paras.en: The Houthis said they were retaliating for what they call a Saudi blockade of their territory, as well as an air strike on Sanaa airport that they blamed on the kingdom.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们正在对他们所谓的沙特对其领土的封锁以及对萨那机场的空袭进行报复，他们将此归咎于沙特。

paras.en: The conflict escalated in September after the Houthis seized part of Yemen's south-western Red Sea coast near the Bab al-Mandab Strait, a chokepoint for global shipping. Their advance contributed to a rise in oil prices following six months of war between the US, Israel and Iran.
paras.zh: 9月，胡塞武装占领了也门西南部红海海岸靠近Bab al-Mandab海峡的部分地区，这是全球航运的咽喉。在美国、以色列和伊朗之间的战争持续了六个月之后，他们的进步促成了油价的上涨。

paras.en: Last week, pro-government forces said they had regained control of territory overlooking Bab al-Mandab after launching a major counter-offensive with the support of Saudi air strikes.
paras.zh: 上周，亲政府部队表示，在沙特空袭的支持下发动大规模反攻后，他们已经重新控制了俯瞰Bab al-Mandab的领土。

paras.en: At least 1,282 people have been killed and 5,890 injured in the fighting in Yemen since 6 August, according to the government's health ministry.
paras.zh: 根据政府卫生部的数据，自8月6日以来，也门至少有1,282人在战斗中丧生， 5,890人受伤。

paras.en: The UN says another 201,000 people have been displaced and that there has been an alarming surge in suspected cholera cases.
paras.zh: 联合国表示，另有201,000人流离失所，疑似霍乱病例激增，令人担忧。

articles.title: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded

paras.en: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded
paras.zh: “这真的很难相信” -俄勒冈州小学枪击事件是如何展开的

paras.en: Four victims, including a teacher and three children aged 5, 8 and 11, were killed in a shooting at a primary school in the US state of Oregon, local police say.
paras.zh: 当地警方称，包括1名教师和3名5岁、8岁和11岁儿童在内的4名受害者在美国俄勒冈州一所小学的枪击事件中丧生。

paras.en: A 16-year-old suspect forced his way into the school by firing at locked doors. He was also killed in the shooting by an armed member of the community who followed the suspect inside the school, police said at a press conference.
paras.zh: 一名16岁的嫌疑人向锁着的门开枪，强行进入学校。警方在新闻发布会上说，他还在枪击事件中被一名社区武装人员杀害，该成员在学校内跟踪嫌疑人。

paras.en: Two additional victims, a 7-year-old and another teacher, were hurt and transported to hospital in critical condition.
paras.zh: 另外两名受害者，一名7岁儿童和另一名教师受伤并被送往医院，情况危急。

articles.title: Three children and teacher killed in US primary school shooting

paras.en: A 16-year-old has shot dead three children and a teacher at a primary school in the US state of Oregon before he was killed by a bystander, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，一名16岁的男孩在被一名旁观者杀死之前，在美国俄勒冈州的一所小学开枪打死了三名儿童和一名教师。

paras.en: The suspect, who has not been named, forced his way into Silver Rail Elementary School in the city of Bend on Thursday afternoon by shooting at locked doors, Bend Police Chief Mike Krantz said.
paras.zh: 本德警察局局长迈克·克兰茨（ Mike Krantz ）说，这名尚未透露姓名的嫌疑人于周四下午向上锁的门开枪，强行进入本德市的银轨小学。

paras.en: The teenager was shot dead by a community member who "pursued him into the school and engaged him", Krantz said.
paras.zh: Krantz说，这名少年被一名社区成员枪杀，该社区成员“追赶他进入学校并与他交往”。

paras.en: The three children killed were aged five, eight and 11. A seven-year-old and a 54-year-old teacher were taken to a hospital in a critical condition, Krantz said. It is unclear if the attacker had any links to the school.
paras.zh: 遇难的三名儿童分别为5岁、8岁和11岁。Krantz说，一名7岁和一名54岁的教师被送往医院，情况危急。目前尚不清楚袭击者是否与学校有任何联系。

paras.en: "We are stunned and heartbroken by this senseless tragedy," Steven Cook, the top administrative official of the local school district, said in a statement.
paras.zh: “我们对这场毫无意义的悲剧感到震惊和心碎，”当地学区最高行政官员史蒂文库克在一份声明中说。

paras.en: "No words can adequately express the grief our community is experiencing."
paras.zh: 「没有任何言语可以充分表达我们社区正在经历的悲痛。」

paras.en: Police said the attacker was a local 16-year-old boy, but they did not release any further details on him or the identity of the victims.
paras.zh: 警方称袭击者是一名当地16岁的男孩，但他们没有透露有关他或受害者身份的任何进一步细节。

paras.en: Police were alerted to an active shooter at Silver Rail Elementary at 12:59 local time (04:59 BST), Bend Police Department spokeswoman Sheila Miller told reporters.
paras.zh: Bend警察局发言人Sheila Miller告诉记者，当地时间12:59 （英国夏令时04:59 ） ，警方接到Silver Rail Elementary现场枪手的警报。

paras.en: The first call came from a person who said that an unknown suspect was shooting into their car with a long gun, police said. Photos released from the scene show a red truck with bullet holes.
paras.zh: 警方称，第一个电话来自一个人，他说一名不明身份的嫌疑人正在用长枪射击他们的车。现场发布的照片显示，一辆红色卡车上有弹孔。

paras.en: Minutes later, the local county dispatch received 911 calls reporting that the attacker had entered the school.
paras.zh: 几分钟后，当地县派出人员接到911个电话，称袭击者已进入学校。

paras.en: Police said he shot at locks on the doors in order to force his way inside.
paras.zh: 警方说，他朝门上的锁开枪，以迫使他进去。

paras.en: Local media reports suggested the school received new classroom doors in 2022 which can be locked with the flip of a switch.
paras.zh: 当地媒体报道称，学校在2022年获得了新的教室门，可以通过翻转开关锁定。

paras.en: A bystander saw the shooting begin to unfold, pursued the attacker into the school and shot him dead, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，一名旁观者看到枪击事件开始展开，追赶袭击者进入学校并开枪打死他。

paras.en: Three minutes later, officers first arrived at the scene. They confirmed that the attacker had been killed, and then searched the school.
paras.zh: 三分钟后，警察先到了现场。他们证实袭击者已被杀害，然后搜查了学校。

paras.en: Schools in Bend have been closed on Friday. Officials said the community needed time to heal.
paras.zh: 本德的学校周五关闭。官员们说，社区需要时间来恢复。

paras.en: Around 450 children attend Silver Rail Elementary School, which has more than 40 adult staff members, police said.
paras.zh: 警方称，约有450名儿童就读于银轨小学，该校有40多名成人工作人员。

paras.en: According to the K-12 School Shooting Database, there were 235 shooting incidents at American schools last year and at least 140 so far this year.

articles.title: CELEBRATING 100 YEARS

paras.en: MEDINA, OH (January 6, 2025) – Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF), a global leader in brake and friction technology and part of the CentroMotion family of brands, has reached a momentous milestone – its 100th anniversary.
paras.zh: 俄亥俄州梅迪纳（2025 年 1 月 6 日）——制动和摩擦技术领域的全球领导者、CentroMotion 品牌家族的成员之一 Carlisle Brake & Friction (CarlisleCBF) 迎来了一个重要的里程碑——成立 100 周年。

paras.en: Since its founding in 1925, the company has lived up to its tagline, "Braking New Ground," by consistently pioneering innovative solutions that have propelled industries forward.
paras.zh: 自 1925 年成立以来，该公司一直践行其口号“开辟新天地”，不断开拓创新解决方案，推动行业向前发展。

paras.en: "For 100 years, Carlisle has been synonymous with groundbreaking innovation and unwavering reliability in the braking industry," says Tom Vanderlaan, Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) of CentroMotion. "This milestone is a testament to the dedication of our employees, the trust of our customers, and the enduring strength of our products. As we celebrate our centennial, we reaffirm our commitment to continuous innovation, strong partnerships, and giving back to the communities we serve."
paras.zh: CentroMotion 首席商务官 (CCO) Tom Vanderlaan 表示：“100 年来，Carlisle 一直是制动行业突破性创新和坚定可靠性的代名词。” “这一里程碑证明了我们员工的奉献、客户的信任以及我们产品的持久实力。在庆祝我们百年华诞之际，我们重申我们对持续创新、强有力的合作伙伴关系以及回馈我们所服务的社区的承诺。”

paras.en: A Century of Innovation in Motion Control
paras.zh: 运动控制的一个世纪的创新

paras.en: For a century, CarlisleCBF has been at the forefront of motion control, pushing the boundaries of performance with its industry-leading brakes and friction materials. Through unwavering commitment to R&D, the company has earned the trust of customers worldwide, establishing itself as a cornerstone of reliability.
paras.zh: 一个世纪以来，CarlisleCBF 一直处于运动控制领域的前沿，凭借其行业领先的制动器和摩擦材料突破了性能界限。通过坚定不移地致力于研发，该公司赢得了全球客户的信任，奠定了其可靠性的基石。

paras.en: Celebrating 100 Years of Braking New Ground: A Digital Celebration
paras.zh: 庆祝开拓新天地 100 周年：数字庆典

paras.en: To commemorate this historic milestone, CarlisleCBF is launching a comprehensive digital celebration. This virtual experience will allow customers, employees and industry partners to delve into the company’s rich history, groundbreaking innovations and commitment to excellence through historical photographs and stories.
paras.zh: 为了纪念这一历史性里程碑，CarlisleCBF 推出了全面的数字庆祝活动。这种虚拟体验将使客户、员工和行业合作伙伴能够通过历史照片和故事深入了解公司丰富的历史、突破性的创新和对卓越的承诺。

paras.en: A core aspect of the celebration is fostering a sense of community. CarlisleCBF invites customers, employees and industry partners to join the journey by visiting their dedicated anniversary webpage, www.CarlisleCBF.com, and following their story on social media.
paras.zh: 庆祝活动的一个核心方面是培养社区意识。 CarlisleCBF 邀请客户、员工和行业合作伙伴通过访问其专门的周年纪念网页 www.CarlisleCBF.com 并在社交媒体上关注他们的故事来加入这一旅程。

paras.en: The webpage and social media channels will serve as a virtual time capsule, showcasing CarlisleCBF's rich history, ground-breaking milestones and product innovations.
paras.zh: 网页和社交媒体渠道将充当虚拟时间胶囊，展示 CarlisleCBF 丰富的历史、突破性的里程碑和产品创新。

paras.en: To encourage participation and celebrate the impact CarlisleCBF has had, a social media campaign is launching with the hashtag #CarlisleCBF100. Participants are encouraged to share stories, photos and memories that illustrate how CarlisleCBF products have impacted their lives or businesses. The most engaging submissions will be featured on the company's social media channels and website.
paras.zh: 为了鼓励参与并庆祝 CarlisleCBF 所产生的影响，一项社交媒体活动正在启动，主题标签为#CarlisleCBF100。我们鼓励参与者分享故事、照片和回忆，以说明 CarlisleCBF 产品如何影响他们的生活或业务。最具吸引力的提交内容将在公司的社交媒体渠道和网站上展示。

paras.en: By combining digital storytelling with interactive social media, CarlisleCBF aims to create a lasting legacy for its first century of service, while fostering a spirit of community and appreciation.
paras.zh: 通过将数字故事讲述与互动社交媒体相结合，CarlisleCBF 旨在为其第一个世纪的服务创造持久的遗产，同时培养社区和欣赏精神。

paras.en: Carlisle Brake & Friction, a CentroMotion brand, is a globally recognized leader in the development and manufacture of highly innovative brake and friction system solutions to service a diverse range of motion control applications. The comprehensive nature of CarlisleCBF's brake system expertise includes hydraulic control products, industrial brake assemblies, and wet and dry friction material for brake, clutch, and transmission applications, as well as aftermarket replacement products. Our full-system product offering, supported by our industry-experience staff of experts, provides our customers with brake system solutions that set them apart from their competition. www.carlislecbf.com
paras.zh: Carlisle Brake & Friction 是 CentroMotion 旗下品牌，在开发和制造高度创新的制动和摩擦系统解决方案方面是全球公认的领导者，为各种运动控制应用提供服务。 CarlisleCBF 制动系统专业知识的综合性包括液压控制产品、工业制动组件、用于制动、离合器和变速箱应用的湿式和干式摩擦材料，以及售后替换产品。我们的全系统产品由具有行业经验的专家团队提供支持，为我们的客户提供制动系统解决方案，使他们在竞争中脱颖而出。 www.carlislecbf.com

paras.en: CentroMotion designs and delivers highly engineered products that enhance the safety, reliability and productivity of equipment used in transportation, agriculture, construction, mining and demanding industrial environments. Our innovative team works collaboratively with customers through our family of trusted, established brands, bringing deep subject-matter expertise in complementary technologies.
paras.zh: CentroMotion 设计并提供高度工程化的产品，可提高运输、农业、建筑、采矿和苛刻工业环境中使用的设备的安全性、可靠性和生产率。我们的创新团队通过值得信赖的知名品牌与客户合作，带来互补技术方面深厚的专业知识。

paras.en: This expertise, combined with our exceptional scale and geographic reach, makes us a reliable partner to help our customers achieve their goals, and provide end users with the best equipment possible. Our well-known brands include Power-Packer for hydraulic motion control and stabilization systems; CrossControl and maximatecc for operator information and human-machine interface systems; Elliott Manufacturing and Weasler Engineering for power and force transmission through flexible and rigid driveline systems; Gits Manufacturing for high-performance engine thermal and emission control solutions; and Carlisle Brake & Friction for materials and mechatronic solutions for off-highway brake and transmission products. Learn more about CentroMotion at www.centromotion.com.
paras.zh: 这种专业知识与我们卓越的规模和地理覆盖范围相结合，使我们成为可靠的合作伙伴，帮助我们的客户实现他们的目标，并为最终用户提供最好的设备。我们的知名品牌包括用于液压运动控制和稳定系统的 Power-Packer；用于操作员信息和人机界面系统的 CrossControl 和 maximatecc； Elliott Manufacturing 和 Weasler Engineering 通过柔性和刚性传动系统进行动力和力传输； Gits Manufacturing 提供高性能发动机热和排放控制解决方案；和 Carlisle Brake & Friction，为非公路制动和传动产品提供材料和机电一体化解决方案。如需了解有关 CentroMotion 的更多信息，请访问 www.centromotion.com。

paras.zh: CarlisleCBF 是参加 2025 年 11 月 9 日至 15 日在德国汉诺威举行的 Agritechnica 展会的七个 CentroMotion 品牌之一，展位号为 B35，展厅 17。

paras.zh: CentroMotion 是一家全球制造公司，专注于摩擦、信息和控制、机械动力传输以及热和运动控制产品。

paras.en: Our teams will showcase various products that serve the agriculture market:
paras.zh: 我们的团队将展示服务于农业市场的各种产品：

paras.en: Sharing a powerful lineup of brake system solutions engineered for the demands of modern agriculture equipment. Attendees can explore highlights from industry-leading brake assemblies, designed to deliver unmatched stopping power and durability in off-highway environments. paras.zh: 分享一系列强大的制动系统解决方案，专为满足现代农业设备的需求而设计。与会者可以探索行业领先的制动组件的亮点，这些组件旨在在非公路环境中提供无与伦比的制动力和耐用性。该显示器还将采用 EPD 和 N680 先进摩擦技术，旨在优化高扭矩应用中的性能和可靠性。这些产品共同代表了一个世纪以来的卓越工程技术和着眼于未来解决农业移动领域最严峻挑战的承诺。

paras.zh: 展示用于机器智能和 HMI 解决方案的领先机载计算平台。专为满足农业机械需求而设计的新产品包括10英寸和12英寸智能终端、带显示器的中央车辆计算以及具有用于触觉控制的可编程软键的5英寸和7英寸显示器。 CCpilot V1090 和 V1290 是首款具有集成网络交换机的显示器，可以更轻松地将摄像头系统、传感器和精密系统等元素整合到一台显示计算机中。车载电脑和显示器（CrossCore A100，显示器尺寸从10英寸到12英寸）突出了新的集中式计算架构。这种方法为车辆智能提供了一个灵活、可扩展的平台。它包括创新的组件生命周期管理和增加对功能安全的支持。

Five different flexible drive shaft agricultural systems are available, and the assemblies fit most planters on the market today.
paras.zh: 重点介绍 Elliott 的灵活种植产品如何在无需额外电源的情况下提供精确的性能、高度的运行可靠性和机械优势。灵活的驱动和控制轴产品为原始设备机械带来了增强的性能，提供简单可靠的售后升级，为您带来持续的投资回报。有五种不同的柔性驱动轴农业系统可供选择，这些组件适合当今市场上的大多数播种机。

paras.en: Learn about Weasler’s range of products, from drive shafts and torque limiters to dampers and other components, all designed using the best technology to solve our customers’ power transmission problems. paras.zh: Farmers 是 NABC 的一级会员，通过 NABC Recycled Rides 向有需要的人和组织捐赠了近 100 辆汽车。
